# 🥊 **Fight Night: How It Works**
Fight Night just got a serious upgrade. The bot now tracks every aUEC that moves through the night: buy-ins, bets, winnings, all of it. No more scribbled notes and "wait, who owed who?" At the end, you get one payout for everything you won.
** Want to fight?**
Click **Join** on the fight card, then pay your buy-in to the Treasurer. You have to sign up through the bot, even if you're standing right next to the Treasurer with cash in hand. If it's not in the bot, it doesn't count.
Once the Treasurer confirms your payment, your ⏳ turns into a ✅ and you're in.

items.title: **__Org News__**
items.body:
🚀 The First SDAS Comic Is Here!
With the release of SDAS's first official comic, we're excited to announce a brand-new addition to the SDAS website!
You'll now find a "Comics" tab at the top of the website, where you can explore comics and stories created by members of Some Dudes and a Spaceship!
📖 Here's how it works:
Read & Explore: Browse comics and stories created by fellow SDAS members.
Create & Share: Members with the rank of Prospect or higher can publish their own original comics and stories for everyone to enjoy.
Join the Conversation: Anyone, including non-members, can read, like, and comment on published content!

items.title: **__Org Announcement__**
items.body:
everyone
SDAS has always been a pretty drama-free community, and that’s something we’re proud of. We have people here from all walks of life, with different backgrounds, beliefs, and opinions. At the end of the day, we’re all here for the same reason: to hang out, play Star Citizen, and enjoy being part of the Dudes.
However, one issue that has come up more than once recently is real-world politics, and it’s something we need to address.
Everyone is entitled to their own political opinions and beliefs. We aren’t here to tell anyone what they should or shouldn’t believe. But those discussions have no place in this Discord.
Effective immediately, we’ve added Rule #3: No Real-World Politics.

items.title: 🦃 **__Happy Thanksgiving, Dudes!__**
items.body:
From all of us at Some Dudes and a Spaceship, we want to wish everyone a Happy Thanksgiving!
Enjoy some good food, crack open a cold one, and spend some time with family and friends. For those spending their holiday in the Verse, may your servers be stable, your ships stay intact, and your cargo actually make it to its destination.
Thanks for being part of SDAS and making this community a damn good place to hang out.
Eat well, drink responsibly, and fly dangerously. 🍻
From SDAS Leadership. everyone
